title: Live Trading Budget v0.1
description: An operator-registered, self-hashed record of the live-trading risk caps, venue and symbol allowlist. A record registered since 2026-09-15 (PR1r) carries no validity window and stands until it is re-registered or deleted; one registered before still carries its window and is still held to it. Replaces the LP3 environment-variable caps with an auditable record: changing a limit produces a new record rather than a silent env edit, and every future order's audit can reference this record's hash. Registering it grants nothing and enables no trading (see LIVE_EXECUTION_GOVERNANCE_V0.1.md item 6).

venue.description: The single venue this runtime supports. An enum, not a free string, so a typo cannot register a budget for a venue the code cannot reach.

symbol_allowlist.description: The symbols a live order may target. Non-empty; an order for a symbol outside this list is refused.

max_order_notional_usdt.description: Per-order notional cap. Must be > 0 (zero would read as unconfigured = halted) and <= absolute_max_notional_usdt (cross-field, enforced by the builder).

absolute_max_notional_usdt.description: The hard ceiling a per-order cap can never exceed. Capped at 500 USDT (200 until 2026-08-08; raised on Thomas's instruction after the live path earned its canary evidence): a configured cap above the ceiling is refused, never clamped. Kept in step with live_budget.HARD_CEILING_USDT, which refuses first so the error names the offending number.

daily_loss_limit_usdt.description: Realized-loss limit per UTC day. Must be > 0 — an unconfigured loss limit reads as breached.

min_clean_canary_orders.description: Retired 2026-09-15 (PR1r): accepted on records registered before, never written, never read. Kept declared because this object is closed and those records are self-hashed: dropping the property would make them schema-invalid, and stripping it from a record would break its hash.

valid_from.description: Legacy (before 2026-09-15, PR1r): honoured when present; never written. A record carries both valid_from and valid_until, opening before it closes, or neither; half a window reads invalid (enforced on read by live_budget, since this schema cannot pair or order them). Kept declared because this object is closed and those records are self-hashed.

valid_until.description: Legacy (before 2026-09-15, PR1r): honoured when present; never written. Outside [valid_from, valid_until] the budget reads invalid (OUTSIDE_VALIDITY_WINDOW). See valid_from for the pairing rule.
